I'm resolving both scan hits as backlog items. Neither is a no-action decision, and I can't write `→ dropped:` without your word.

- **Line 13:** payload compression is deferred work you want before the winter deployment. It gets a `Done when:` item, so it ages.
- **Line 36:** the 64 MB buffer stays unless `BUFFER_FULL` shows up. That has one concrete signal, so it is a `Revisit if:` watch item.

Step 2 wrote "nothing deferred" in the status header, which is now wrong, so I'm correcting it.

First, check that this is a git repo, because the environment says it isn't:

<command>git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree</command>

If that fails, I'd use plain `mv` below and skip the commits.

**4. Commit the markers and items.**

<command>git add specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md specs/deferred_items.md && git commit -m "docs(specs): file plan 12 deferrals"</command>

</edit>

<command>mkdir -p specs/plans/completed specs/completed && git mv specs/plans/12-station-upload-retry.md specs/plans/completed/12-station-upload-retry.md && git mv specs/station-upload-retry.md specs/completed/station-upload-retry.md && git add specs && git commit -m "chore(specs): retire plan 12"</command>

I'd run `git status` afterwards to confirm the tree is clean.

**Message to my partner:**

Both scan hits were real deferrals, so I filed them rather than dropping them.

- **Payload compression (line 13):** this is wanted before winter, so it went into `specs/deferred_items.md` as a `Size: plan` item with a `Done when:`. Because it's wanted, it will age and count toward the 45-day gate.
- **64 MB buffer (line 36):** this is a `Size: quick-fix` watch item with `Revisit if:` a station's health log reports `BUFFER_FULL`. It doesn't age.
- **Status header:** step 2 said "nothing deferred", which was wrong, since the compression sentence was a deferral the gate missed. I changed it to "deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md". The backlog is now 9 open, and the aged count is still 0.

I'd retire both the plan and the spec. Plan 12 is the only plan naming that spec.

If you'd rather treat the buffer line as a settled decision, tell me and I'll write `→ dropped:` there instead and remove that item.

The environment reports this directory isn't a git repo, though the session says the branch is `feat/upload-retry`. If the `git rev-parse` check fails, I'll use plain `mv` and make no commits. Tell me if you'd rather I stop there.
